hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that fully manages swap execution through Euler Finance lending vaults, bypassing Uniswap's internal pool math. In beforeSwap, it takes input tokens and deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, returns a BeforeSwapDelta, and enforces a custom bonding curve invariant on reserves. Standard liquidity provision and donations are blocked.
